name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: ZCode session-level token rate monitor — the instant tok/s of the just-finished turn is shown automatically when each reply ends; with a real-time dashboard, /tps command and MCP tools, plus optional service-TPS monitoring via a real metrics endpoint or demo data.

metrics_url.description: HTTP endpoint returning JSON with a tps/qps field; empty = demo data.
